**Implementation note:** HRP reduces to inverse-variance weights for uncorrelated assets (catalog S6).

## Description

Weights assets inversely to estimated volatility, so lower-volatility assets receive larger allocations.

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset allocation where volatility estimates are informative and the goal is to reduce risk concentration.

## Vehicles

Multi-asset, ETF, risk-based and defensive portfolios.

## Required data

Historical returns or prices for each asset, rolling volatility estimator, rebalance calendar and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Ignores correlations unless extended; volatility estimates can lag regime changes and may create unwanted concentration.
